description: Wire the full SEO layer: per-route metadata via the Head component (title, meta description, canonical, OG + Twitter), JSON-LD structured data (Organization + LocalBusiness, Person per founder, Service per each of the 7 services, BreadcrumbList on interior pages), a generated sitemap.xml from the routes array, robots.txt with a Sitemap directive, and a host-agnostic 301 for /referral-programme -> /referral. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003 (pages and routes must exist). Do NOT create SEO_URL_MAPPING.md.
steps: Read context.json FIRST. Create src/lib/seo.ts with SITE_URL='https://www.kradvisorygroup.co.za' (no trailing slash) and canonical/OG builders. Flesh out src/components/seo/Head.tsx to set per-route <title>, meta description (verbatim where CONTENT_INVENTORY.md gives one), canonical (SITE_URL+path), OG (title/description/type/url/image=/hero.jpg) and Twitter card. Apply Head to every page via its route meta from src/content/seo.ts.

Create src/lib/jsonld.ts builders: Organization + LocalBusiness (name, verified address 64 Eagle Street, Kikuyu Estate, Waterfall, Midrand, Johannesburg; phone +27734997148; url SITE_URL; sameAs socials), Person per verified founder (name + jobTitle ONLY, no bio), Service per each of the 7 verified services, BreadcrumbList for interior pages. Inject via JsonLd on the appropriate pages (Org/LocalBusiness site-wide or on Home; Service[] on /services; BreadcrumbList on /services, /about, /contact, /referral).

Create src/scripts/generate-sitemap.ts that imports the routes array from src/routes.tsx and writes dist/sitemap.xml listing / /services /about /contact /referral (absolute URLs on SITE_URL). Confirm it is wired into the build script (npm run build runs it after the SSG build).

Create public/robots.txt with permissive allow rules and 'Sitemap: https://www.kradvisorygroup.co.za/sitemap.xml'. Create public/_redirects with '/referral-programme /referral 301' (Netlify/Cloudflare) and add a brief clearly-labeled note (README or a comment) for the equivalent vercel.json redirect. Keep minimal.
Commit locally (do NOT push): 'feat: add SEO layer - Head, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, redirect'. Set FEAT-004 status to completed and record notes in findings.
acceptance_criteria: Every built route HTML contains a <link rel="canonical"> on https://www.kradvisorygroup.co.za and a unique <title> + meta description.
Built HTML contains application/ld+json with Organization/LocalBusiness, Person (founders, name+jobTitle only), Service (7), and BreadcrumbList on interior pages.
dist/sitemap.xml exists and lists all five routes as absolute SITE_URL URLs.
public/_redirects contains the 301 /referral-programme -> /referral; SEO_URL_MAPPING.md was NOT created.
verification: Run: npm run build  (succeeds; emits dist/sitemap.xml)
Confirm dist/index.html (and interior routes) contain 'rel="canonical"' and 'application/ld+json'
Confirm public/_redirects contains '/referral-programme' and '/referral' with 301, and that SEO_URL_MAPPING.md does not exist
findings: Implemented the full SEO layer on top of the FEAT-001/002/003 scaffolding. Head.tsx extended with Open Graph (og:type=website, site_name, title, description, url, image=SITE_URL/hero.jpg) and Twitter (summary_large_image) tags; title/description/canonical already applied per route from src/content/seo.ts (unique per page). Added ogImage() helper to src/lib/seo.ts. Created src/lib/jsonld.ts with builders: organization() + localBusiness() (verified address 64 Eagle Street, Kikuyu Estate / Waterfall, Midrand / Johannesburg, phone +27734997148, url SITE_URL, sameAs = 5 socials, logo /kr-logo.png), founders() = Person per founder with name + jobTitle ONLY (no bios fabricated), serviceList() = Service per each of the 7 verified services, and breadcrumbs() for interior pages. Injected via JsonLd: Org+LocalBusiness on Home; Service[7]+BreadcrumbList on /services; Person[2]+BreadcrumbList on /about; BreadcrumbList on /contact and /referral. generate-sitemap.ts and public/robots.txt (with Sitemap directive) already existed and were left as-is; the sitemap generator is wired into `npm run build`. Created public/_redirects with the 301 '/referral-programme  /referral  301' (Netlify/Cloudflare) and vercel.json with the equivalent permanent redirect plus a labeled _note to keep both in sync. Did NOT create SEO_URL_MAPPING.md. Verification: `npm run build` succeeds and emits dist/sitemap.xml; built HTML per route contains rel="canonical" on https://www.kradvisorygroup.co.za and application/ld+json (home: Organization+LocalBusiness; about: Person x2 + BreadcrumbList; services: Service x7 + BreadcrumbList; contact/referral: BreadcrumbList); dist/sitemap.xml lists all 5 routes as absolute SITE_URL URLs; dist/robots.txt contains the Sitemap line; OG+Twitter tags present in built HTML; public/_redirects has the 301; SEO_URL_MAPPING.md absent; tsc --noEmit clean.
